items.title: Typed inputs/results and canonical codecs
items.remaining_design_output: Complete source custody envelopes, calendar batch input, Account/workflow/adoption fields and every nullable/reference/range rule
items.design_exit: No generic TypedRef/payload holes in any selected callable boundary; every actual codec and maximum transport witness named
items.later_execution_evidence: Schema/codec tests and mutation/boundary execution after approved test/implementation stages

items.title: Physical schema and owner transactions
items.remaining_design_output: Consolidate13-22 tables/keys; seven source/head/claim DDL; source reciprocal FKs; all finalizer/actor/gate/adoption/ACL bodies
items.design_exit: Every selected write has exact SQL identity/constraint/caller/lock/index contract;22 structural member SQL does not close whole item
items.later_execution_evidence: Run clean/upgrade PostgreSQL catalogs, roles, races, rollback and query plans

items.title: Retention and independent adoption
items.remaining_design_output: Exact private/staged/domain units, seal linkage, required submission copies/pins, disposal states and external issuance serialization
items.design_exit: Concrete adapter/provider contracts and complete copy/lifetime inventory; no placeholder that cleanup may erase required evidence
items.later_execution_evidence: Provider fault/hold/cancel/readback and restore tests, actual issued credentials

items.title: Execution identity and information flow
items.remaining_design_output: Actual roles/processes/pools/caller provenance; source legacy-shape refusal; complete source->sink map, active customer tenant/Cedar/egress contracts; typed DB-error projection across response/log/trace sinks and DB-side diagnostics configuration
items.design_exit: All trusted/unverified boundaries and allowed releases declared; no missing caller or job-title authority; exact Verus relational properties
items.later_execution_evidence: Verus proofs on actual exec code; safe API/nonvacuity checks; runtime isolation/RLS/egress/log checks

items.title: Migration and enrollment
items.remaining_design_output: Exact legacy/catalog census, restartable backfill/quarantine, dependency manifest, cutover/rollback/compatible readers
items.design_exit: Deterministic phases and repair/rollback rules; no legacy fact gets fabricated qualified provenance
items.later_execution_evidence: Execute clean and seeded upgrade/rollback under reviewed test/implementation versions

items.title: Independent journal and custody selection
items.remaining_design_output: Select concrete holder/provider capability and append/CAS/idempotency/signature/rollover/serving-fence protocol
items.design_exit: Choose supported design, dependencies and failure rules; actual vendor deployment evidence is later
items.later_execution_evidence: Provision separately authorized services and verify independent append/readback/fences

items.title: Recovery and current authority
items.remaining_design_output: Specify independent source/freshness/completeness for identities, grants, topology, effects, work and gates
items.design_exit: Restore cannot serve merely because historical rows load; explicit reconciliation/unknown/refusal/readmission rules
items.later_execution_evidence: Execute restore/loss/revocation/rerun drills with actual independent sources

items.title: Executable verification and deployment plan
items.remaining_design_output: Name harnesses, role/bootstrap fixtures, clock/barriers/fault points, pilot envelope and p95/p99/resource/error denominators
items.design_exit: Precise tests/proofs/measurements to write, assumptions and acceptance criteria; no need to claim results before implementation
items.later_execution_evidence: Run tests/proofs/load after approved implementation; release evidence separately

Information-flow proof or full sink audit
implementation_distance: Still in design completion, not almost coding. No defensible percent/time estimate from candidate count; each item closes on listed outputs, not more prose or repeated scoped reviews.
anti_expansion_rule: Prior71 conceptual relations are an inventory, not permission to create71 tables. Reuse existing owners/storage; every additional relation requires a concrete unresolved invariant. Update this finite map by evidence, not a new independent checklist per example.
pilot: Console operated;1 customer Group tenant,6 Companies,2000 total people. Cross-customer negative fixtures use a distinct second tenant; not a change to pilot population.
production_separate: Actual provider/credential deployment, legal/payment authority and production exposure are later separately authorized evidence; do not confuse them with writing a complete design contract.
map_boundary: F01-F08 elaborate W04 technical integration only. They do not replace W01-W03 user workflow/screen/self-service closure, authorize the full interview scope, or establish whole Foundry-suite readiness.

first_slice_reconciliation.authority_exit: Reconcile selected scope with current PRODUCT/ROADMAP through reviewed authority work before implementation; interview evidence alone does not release communications, office editing or other existing HOLDs.

full_console_boundary: First implementation, pilot operation and full Console completion are distinct.08 FULL01-FULL05 remain separate work: shared engine, complete HR/attendance/labor/payroll story inventory, communications/calendar UX, enterprise coediting sheets, and versioned leaf-level Foundry-suite capability inventory/acceptance. Do not require the entire suite finished before the first coherent implementation slice; do not silently drop these requested capabilities.
